test_title: PYST 06: SSC Stenographer 2025: General Awareness (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question: What is the purpose of the 'Beti Bachao Beti Padhao' scheme ?

options.text: Saving and educating the girl child

solution:
The correct answer is __**Saving and educating the girl child**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Beti Bachao Beti Padhao** (BBBP) is a flagship scheme launched by the Government of India in **January 2015**.
 
• The primary aim of the scheme is to address the declining **Child Sex Ratio (CSR)** and promote the survival, protection, and education of the girl child.
 
• It is a joint initiative by three ministries: **Ministry of Women and Child Development (MWCD)**, **Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW)**, and **Ministry of Education (MoE).**
 
• The scheme focuses on **community-level engagement** and awareness campaigns to challenge societal norms and discrimination against girls.
 
• It also emphasizes **ensuring girls' access to quality education** and improving their overall status in society.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Child Sex Ratio (CSR):** CSR refers to the number of girls per 1,000 boys in the age group of 0–6 years. As per the 2011 Census, the CSR in India was 919, indicating a declining trend.
 
• **Implementation Strategy:** The scheme operates in **multi-sectoral districts** with poor CSR, focusing on community mobilization, institutional support, and stringent enforcement of laws like the **PCPNDT Act** (Pre-Conception and Pre-Natal Diagnostic Techniques Act).
 
• **Increased Awareness:** BBBP has popularized slogans like **"Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao"** and campaigns that encourage gender equality and educate parents about the importance of girls' education.
 
• **Key Achievements:** The scheme has led to an improvement in CSR in certain districts and increased enrollment of girls in schools, particularly at the secondary level.
 
• **Related Programs:** BBBP is synergized with other schemes like **Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana** (a savings scheme for girl children) to provide financial security and encourage education.
